metaDescription: An open-source, self-hosted personal finance app with double-entry bookkeeping, multi-currency accounts and investment tracking. Still in development.
developmentSummary: Pre-release software. Features and data structures are still changing.
screenshotNote: The screenshots show the English interface with fictional data.
reportAlt: Rekenraam spending report showing categorized expenses and their share of total spending in the light theme on the left and the dark theme on the right, using fictional sample data.
ledgerBody: Balanced entries and exact decimal amounts across currencies. Account hierarchies, split transactions, transfers, version history and statement reconciliation. Keep original currencies separate or convert reports with exchange rates you can inspect and edit.
investmentBody: Long and short positions, acquisition lots, dividends and reinvestment. Transfers, splits, mergers, spin-offs and return of capital. Realized and unrealized gains under several cost-basis methods. Prices can be entered manually or fetched from optional providers.
transactionsAlt: Rekenraam transaction register populated with fictional transactions in a synthetic reference book.
investmentsAlt: Rekenraam investments screen with positions and acquisition details from a synthetic reference book.
setupBody: Run the single binary or use Docker Compose, then open the interface in a desktop or mobile browser. You manage updates and recovery.
setupMaintenance: For internet access, HTTPS and two-factor authentication are required.
statusBody: Maintained by one person, with substantial use of AI to generate code and documentation. Upgrades between development revisions are not guaranteed; some schema changes may require a database reset.
statusLimits: Online imports currently support Trading 212 only. Receipt attachments, multiple user logins and country-specific tax calculations are not included.
translationNote: Non-English translations are drafts awaiting native-language review.
footerPrivacy: This website has no analytics, tracking scripts or external fonts. The hosting provider may retain access logs.
notFoundBody: This address does not match a page on the Rekenraam website.
storageBody: The database and access are under your control, on your own computer or server. CSV and QIF imports, ledger exports and structured archives. Scheduled, verified database backups and command-line restore. No external account is required.
budgetBody: Monthly category budgets, recurring transactions reviewed before posting and projected balances. Net worth, spending and cashflow reports with drill-down and CSV downloads.
